verdict.rationale: kitty's own docs advertise "programmable tabs, splits and multiple layouts to manage windows," with dedicated sections for the Stack, Tall, Grid and Splits layouts and for resizing windows. Users corroborate this: one names auto layouts as a favorite feature, another found startup tabs easy to set up, and another wants to drop tmux in favor of kitty's multiplexing. missing for 10: evidence of tmux-style session detach/reattach or persistence, in-depth doc content beyond section titles for split and tab navigation, and tab polish (one user calls the tabs underwhelming next to native OS tabs).
